comments.author: Clog
comments.body_html:
Okay firstly, yes you are wrong in declining the overwrite. Not a single file from my mod should overwrite any other mod. If something is asking you to overwrite its because they have the same name and must be updated.

Secondly, you really shouldnt be messing with the load order. Not sure why people do but the default order has always worked for me even with 48 server mods. It goes alphabetically off the names of mods. Thats why SAIN is named zSolaraintSAIN.

Thirdly, if you are having trouble placing markers (Ive had this issue in the past and seems like a FIKA issue) clear your temp files in the SPT launcher.

If you are having troubles I suspect you are installing mods wrong because anyone who installs it correctly should not have this issue. Either that or a load order issue but I have no experience or recommendations for that.
